results.evidence: Reply dataclass fields are lead_id, reply_type, activity_id, suppressed_contact, eligibility_change; no field named eligibility. Grep of cottonwood/ and tests/ finds no remaining reader of a Reply's .eligibility. The only use is self.eligibility_change in lines(). Other 'eligibility' hits are SQL columns, CLI args or review.py's own row type. `uv run --offline pytest -q` gave 931 passed. `uv run --offline mypy .` gave 'Success: no issues found in 106 source files'.
